description: An abstract fragment class for displaying and managing notes in a RecyclerView, with support for selection, toolbar setup, navigation, and note actions.
external_methods: onNoteClick(noteId: Long, position: Int, viewBinding: LayoutNoteBinding)
onNoteLongClick(noteId: Long, position: Int, viewBinding: LayoutNoteBinding): Boolean

classes.name: AbstractNotesFragment
classes.description: An abstract fragment class managing notes display, selection, and actions with RecyclerView and navigation support.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up recycler view, observers, and navigation listeners.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up listeners, adapters, and UI references to prevent leaks.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Updates UI based on new data, including layout and sorting.

methods.name: onNotesChanged
methods.description: Updates the adapter with a new list of notes.

methods.name: onLayoutModeChanged
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to react to layout mode changes.

methods.name: onSortMethodChanged
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to react to sort method changes.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles note click events; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long click on notes; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: onSelectionChanged
methods.description: Updates UI when selection changes.

methods.name: onMessageAvailable
methods.description: Displays a snackbar message.

methods.name: setupSecondaryToolbar
methods.description: Configures secondary toolbar menu actions.

methods.name: setSelectionModeUI
methods.description: Updates UI based on number of selected notes.

methods.name: toggleNoteSelected
methods.description: Toggles selection state of a note.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears all selected notes.

methods.name: selectAllNotes
methods.description: Selects all notes.

methods.name: toggleLayoutMode
methods.description: Switches between list and grid layouts.

methods.name: toggleHiddenNotes
methods.description: Toggles visibility of hidden notes.

methods.name: setHiddenNotesItemActionText
methods.description: Updates menu item checked state for hidden notes.

methods.name: applyNavToEditorAnimation
methods.description: Sets up navigation transition animations.

methods.name: showMenuForNote
methods.description: Displays context menu for a note with various actions.
